Qualcomm announces global job cuts after performance reviews

Chipmaker Qualcomm will implement global job cuts starting in November following annual performance reviews, according to a memo from CEO Cristiano Amon to employees. The company has not specified the number of positions being eliminated as it redirects its focus towards AI data centers. The layoffs are described as performance-focused.
